subject: environmental-science
title: The EIA Process
welcome_lead: Before the bulldozers — predict, mitigate and report environmental consequences.
meta_desc: A-Level Environmental Science adventure on the EIA process and EU Directive.
final_note: EIA front-loads environmental thinking into project design — cheaper than retrofitting.

walkthroughs.body_html: EIA flows: screening → scoping → baseline → impact prediction → mitigation → EIS → decision → monitoring.
Baseline surveys (12 months) characterise habitats, hydrology, air quality and species before construction.
The 1985 Directive made EIA mandatory for Annex I projects (refineries, motorways, large dams) across the EEC.

mcqs.q: Why is ice-albedo feedback a positive feedback loop?
options: Because warming is positive (a good thing).
Because polar bears help spread heat.
They are larger than native species.

mcqs.q: Why are invasive species often more harmful than native species?
options: They lack natural predators or competitors in their new environment, so they spread unchecked.
They are inherently more aggressive than native species.
Because polar bears help spread heat.
They are larger than native species.
